description.fun: Chatot's head is shaped like a musical note, and its tail flicks like a metronome to keep time. With a tongue like a human's, it mimics speech and other Pokémon's cries, and a flock all learns the same saying. Its move Chatter once played back whatever its Trainer recorded, which got Chatot banned from Black and White's online battles, likely over rude recordings.
description.guide: Chatot is a Normal- and Flying-type parrot with a head shaped like a musical note and a metronome-like tail. It can imitate human speech and the cries of other Pokémon, and older ones are said to understand the words. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A music-note parrot that repeats everything it hears.
